name: Lawyers.com

sources.title: Third-party case study — Lawyers.com is owned by Martindale-Avvo; paid listings (~$277/mo example) bundle a martindale.com profile; intake is a phone/sales-rep flow
Third-party directory guide — Lawyers.com offers a free basic attorney profile claim alongside Avvo, Justia, Nolo

conditions: Free basic profiles exist but are auto-populated from public bar data — they are for licensed attorneys only, claimed and completed by the attorney
A SaaS product has no listing surface here at all — this is only relevant if the 'product' is a law firm or a founder is an attorney; skip for software launches
Paid preferred-placement listings exist (~$99–$499/mo per third-party reports, bundled with a martindale.com profile) sold via sales reps
requirements: Licensed attorney with a verifiable bar record — profiles are populated from public bar data
Claim + complete the free profile: practice areas, bio, contact info, website link
preparation: Bar admission details matching public records (name, state, bar number)
Bio, practice areas, firm contact info, website URL
Existing Martindale-Avvo account — Lawyers.com profiles can be linked to/populated from a Martindale profile (same parent company)
workflow: Search lawyers.com for the attorney name — a basic profile likely already exists from bar data
Claim the profile via the for-attorneys flow (site 403s automated fetches; use a browser or the Martindale-Avvo attorney portal)
Complete practice areas, bio, photo, contact and website fields
Decline or evaluate the paid 'Preferred Placement' upsell sold by reps
watchFor: Not applicable to SaaS/software products — no product-listing surface; only attorney/firm profiles
Sales reps push paid placement; the free profile is sufficient for the citation
Same parent company as Avvo/Martindale/Nolo — data can propagate across those properties
countsAsLive: The claimed attorney profile is publicly viewable on lawyers.com with practice areas, bio and website link filled in
unknowns: Exact claim flow (for-attorneys page was bot-blocked)
Whether unclaimed-but-listed profiles show a website link
Current paid listing pricing (third-party quotes vary, ~$99–$499/mo)
